item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight
item.content:encoded: Thank you for your feedback, I see your points and I think it would be good for me to focus on the psychoactive part, so I'll go do that. I was generally just posting to see how this would do since I was just re writing an SCP idea I had a few years ago or so.

item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight
item.content:encoded:
This is interesting. As with many concepts, the question here is "what is the story?", you mention a nuclear meltdown and the spores becoming a big risk to a growing population. But what caused the meltdown? Who shipped it? You simply need to add some more meat to your concept as I do like it.

The aggression towards others and possible self inflicted injury to one affected by the spores psychoactive capabilities

I'll be honest, the aggression towards others isn't very interesting. I've read far too many SCP's with the whole forced aggression spiel. A stronger focus on the psychoactive properties may do your article good, as it's one of the most intriguing parts. If you respond to me please send a PM as I won't get a notification otherwise.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard Format

Elevator Pitch: An organism with lilac orchid flora of which release spores that have corrosive and psychoactive properties. These spores can injure as well as induce increased aggressive behaviour and cause a sudden conviction to "save" or conserve the plant.

Central Narrative: Involvement within a nuclear meltdown event due to its properties have allowed it to grow quite large and spores could present an even higher risk to the growing population outside the nuclear exclusion zone

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The aggression towards others and possible self inflicted injury to one affected by the spores psychoactive capabilities

Additional Notes:
Shipped by unknown import/export company.
